title: draba lutea
intro: Draba lutea, commonly known as yellow whitlowgrass, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. The health benefits of Draba lutea include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and possess anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of Draba lutea include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
